from typing import List

class Solution:
    def continuousSubarrays(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        nums.append(-5)
        start = 0
        count = 0
        sl = []
        sl.append(nums[start])
        
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            sl.append(nums[i])
            while abs(nums[i] - sl[0]) > 2 or abs(nums[i] - sl[-1]) > 2:
                subArrays = len(sl) - 1
                count += subArrays
                sl.remove(nums[start])
                start += 1
        
        return count
